name: Guardian Realms RPG
storyline:
In a realm scarred by war, the mighty Rythguard Empire teeters on the brink of collapse. Once the world’s most powerful force, its control is challenged by the rising Carrowlands Rebellion, whose guerrilla fighters aim to overthrow Imperial rule and forge a new future. As the land fractures, ancient powers and forgotten legends begin to resurface, threatening to reshape the very fabric of existence.

Players take on the role of Artha, a young Imperial captain thrust into a conflict far larger than himself. After a devastating surprise attack shatters the Empire’s defenses, Artha must gather allies, uncover political conspiracies, and battle across war-torn towns, deadly wilderness, and mysterious realms. Along the way, he encounters a diverse cast of companions, each with their own motivations, loyalties, and quests, while facing decisions that will influence the fate of the Realms.

As the rebellion grows stronger and ancient magic awakens, the final clash between Empire and Rebellion will determine whether the world unites under a single banner or descends into chaos. Artha’s journey will lead to revelations about the Guardians, mythical beings tied to the stability of existence itself, and his choices will echo across the Realms for generations to come.
summary:
Guardian Realms RPG is a story-driven fantasy role-playing game set in a war-torn world divided by rebellion, ancient magic, and shifting alliances. Players step into the role of Artha, a young Imperial captain caught in the collapse of the powerful Rythguard Empire, as the Carrowlands Rebellion rises to challenge its dominance.

The game blends classic turn-based combat with exploration, crafting, and side activities like farming, fishing, and cooking. Players can recruit a diverse cast of companions, each with their own quests and storylines, while customizing their party to face powerful enemies and uncover the truth behind the conflict.
